relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: the up-regulation of tumour necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) and interleukin-6 (IL-6) in bone metastases may activate TRPA1 in the sensory neurons of bone cancer rats and contribute to CIBP

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF may also induce the expression of TRPV1 and it is implicated in cancer progression and CIBP

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 is also activated by inflammatory molecules, namely endovanilloids [119], serotonin (5-HT) [120], histamine [121], formaldehyde [122,123], lipid metabolites [124], prostaglandins (PGs) [125], bradykinin (BK) [126]

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Sensory neurons, through the release of CGRP, may impair the cytotoxic potential of tumour-infiltrating CD8+ T cells, leading to their exhaustion [95].

key_findings: Narrative review: TRPV1, TRPA1, TRPM7 and TRPM8 contribute to cancer-induced bone pain via acidosis, inflammatory mediators and NGF signalling.
TRPV1 links sensory neurons, CGRP/substance P release and tumour immunity.
